stem.text: Light of a single frequency passes through two narrow slits and produces an interference pattern on a screen some distance away. The interference fringes are very close together.
Which change would **increase** the distance between the fringes?

A.text: Increase the brightness of the light source.

B.text: Increase the distance between the slits and the screen.

C.text: Increase the distance between the two slits.

D.text: Increase the frequency of the light used.
